text: 939 adds an else branch to release outHeap when the output pointer is absent. The accepted function creates the object with new orkinHeap but uses PR_Free in that branch. The checked class has a virtual, currently empty destructor and no class-specific new/delete overload in its declaration. This is an unresolved static allocation/deallocation pairing concern; it is not a validated allocator or destructor rule to copy. No reachable null-output call or runtime failure was demonstrated, and the review remains unread.
title: Keep the Mork heap leak repair separate from its deallocator concern
